reference_conflict_candidates.subject: Gwyna (Trial Master)
reference_conflict_candidates.findings: Scoreboard 58928 (SAILING_BT_SCOREBOARD_GWENITH_GLIDE) is located 58 tiles away at (2244, 3460, 0). Gwyna is a boat NPC (parent 15105 / morphs 15106-15108). Missing boat NPC on the private server is not proof of absence on live OSRS. Scoreboard is an associated trial object, not a proven boat start tile.
reference_conflict_candidates.disposition: Preserved at authored tile as unresolved placement suspect.

reference_conflict_candidates.subject: Regicide
reference_conflict_candidates.findings: Authored difficulty is listed as Master (canonical OSRS is Experienced). Text states King Lathas in East Ardougne Castle, but authored marker is in Tirannwn (2185, 3145, 0). Canonical quest start already exists at East Ardougne Castle 1st floor (poi_003727 at 2576, 3293, 1). Marker represents regional/Tirannwn quest access rather than initial NPC spawn.
reference_conflict_candidates.disposition: Preserved as confirmed reference conflict; not treated as settled replacement.

reference_conflict_candidates.subject: Making Friends with My Arm
reference_conflict_candidates.findings: Authored difficulty is listed as Experienced (canonical OSRS is Master). Text states 'My Arm in Troll Stronghold' at surface coordinate (2840, 3920, 0). Canonical quest start is Burntmeat in the stronghold kitchen (poi_004033 at 2841, 10060, 1). Surface marker represents stronghold exterior approach/entrance.
reference_conflict_candidates.disposition: Preserved as confirmed reference conflict; not treated as settled replacement.

reference_conflict_candidates.subject: Ferret
reference_conflict_candidates.findings: Conflict between requirement for partial Eagles' Peak quest progress (box trap training during quest) versus full quest completion.
reference_conflict_candidates.disposition: Corrected details to require box traps and Eagles' Peak quest completion; removed false kebbits/deadfall claims.

workflow_improvements.name: Staged Sideload Jar Synchronization Check
workflow_improvements.description: Verify file timestamps between updated source resources and compiled sideloaded jars in .runelite/sideloaded-plugins to avoid prematurely claiming in-game runtime confirmation.
workflow_improvements.benefit: Maintains strict reporting integrity between verified source catalog fixes and pending live-client render states.

workflow_improvements.name: Cross-Catalog Duplicate & Projection Identification
workflow_improvements.description: Search for identical quest titles, NPC names, and calculated offsets across catalog tables to discover whether an authored error is an inaccurate duplicate of an existing correct canonical record.
workflow_improvements.benefit: Prevents redundant relocated markers and exposes authoring anomalies (such as offset surface projections of underground areas).

workflow_improvements.name: Automated Test Assertion Pre-Audit
workflow_improvements.description: Search test files for legacy strings before running test suites to ensure tests asserting old incorrect behavior are updated alongside catalog corrections.
workflow_improvements.benefit: Ensures regressions tests align with verified factual claims without broken test runs.
